description: Firmware self-check reported a version mismatch against the signed manifest.
typical_cause: System BIOS/firmware is out of date or was interrupted during a prior update.
recommended_action: Update firmware to the latest qualified version and re-run the boot diagnostic.

description: Configuration checksum failure detected in NVRAM.
typical_cause: NVRAM settings were corrupted, often after an unclean shutdown or battery depletion.
recommended_action: Reset BIOS/UEFI to defaults, reconfigure boot order, and re-run diagnostics.

description: Secure boot policy violation on startup.
typical_cause: An unsigned or altered boot loader component was detected.
recommended_action: Reinstall trusted boot components from a known-good image and re-enable secure boot.

description: Fan module reporting RPM below minimum threshold.
typical_cause: Fan bearing wear or dust/debris obstruction reducing airflow.
recommended_action: Inspect and clean intake vents; replace fan module if RPM remains below threshold.

description: Redundant fan pair mismatch — one fan idle while its pair is active.
typical_cause: One fan in a redundant pair has failed or is not receiving control signal.
recommended_action: Reseat fan connector; replace the idle fan unit if it remains unresponsive.

description: Predictive failure signal received from drive self-monitoring.
typical_cause: Drive is reporting early indicators of mechanical or media failure.
recommended_action: Back up data immediately and schedule drive replacement before failure occurs.

description: RAID controller battery/cache module reporting degraded charge.
typical_cause: Cache backup battery is nearing end of life.
recommended_action: Replace the cache backup battery/module at the next maintenance window.

description: PCIe link negotiated at a lower width/speed than expected.
typical_cause: Poor seating of the adapter card or a marginal slot connection.
recommended_action: Reseat the adapter card fully and verify slot compatibility; retest link training.

description: PCIe device present but not responding to bus queries.
typical_cause: Card failure, firmware hang on the device, or power delivery fault to the slot.
recommended_action: Reseat the card; test in an alternate slot; replace card if issue persists.

description: Redundant power supply reporting a single-unit failure.
typical_cause: PSU has failed internally or lost input power from its feed.
recommended_action: Verify input power to the failed unit; replace the PSU if it does not recover.

description: Power supply input voltage out of qualified range.
typical_cause: Unstable upstream power source or a loose input connector.
recommended_action: Verify PDU/outlet voltage and reseat the power input connector.
